mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand for new construction, which typically signals expanding economic activity and positive corporate earnings growth, driving S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST rises (compared to baseline) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing the cost of capital and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing output and economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expand.
failure_condition: In early-cycle expansion, INDPRO rising leads to negative SPX 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer spending, which directly drives corporate revenue growth and profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS rises (compared to baseline) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 7.5% signals labor market tightening that increases consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 7.5%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a monetary policy easing cycle that reduces real interest rates, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL falls and FEDFUNDS falls, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production above 98.0 indicates strong manufacturing output, which typically accelerates corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is above 98.0, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases over the last 5 years.
